N1.note: normal errors; variances from the scale part only (no profile)

N6.note: normal; step profile: the data's stayer sample variance by decile of the person effect, applied to stayers and movers; worker-specific factor, CV 1.5

N8.note: violation: movers' profile three times as steep as stayers' (coefficients 1.5 and 0.5)

N9.note: violation: stayers' variance follows the quadratic profile (coefficient 1), movers' does not

N10.note: normal; stayers: the data's stayer profile by decile of the person effect (as N6); movers: the data's own profile, the average leave-out estimate of movers' rows by the same deciles relative to its mean (real-v4); worker-specific factor, CV 1.5

purpose: development study, round 5: adds scenario N10 (movers follow the profile of their own leave-out estimates in the data) and the estimator tl (movers load on the stayers' profile: regressors z*profile and z); N1, N6, N8, N9 repeat round 4 with the same draws (tr and or must reproduce it)
